title: My Amigo Eduardo 5 stars
text: Just about the best historical bike tour i have ever done! Eduardo my guide was amazing and a wealth of information. You d like to think we’re Amigos now!
author: Michael_S

title: The perfect way to see Seville
text: A wonderful way to see Seville.  You can cover so much more ground than on a walking tour, and we used it to orient ourselves at the beginning of our visit.  Our guide Pierre was outstanding; knowledgeable, entertaining and personable with excellent English.  All the central highlights visited and lots more off beat places as well with memorable titbits of stories.  He also gave us some suggestions of places to eat which were all fabulous.
author: 752kayk

title: A great way to experience the history of Seville
text:
We wanted a private tour as so often if your in a group you don’t get to hear what the guides are saying 
Fernando was brilliant, knowledgable and passionate about the history of his city 
He took us to places we would never have known about, taking good care of us especially in the more busy parts of the city 
There was plenty of time and opportunity to take pictures and ask questions
The bikes were comfortable enough especially given they are probably used a lot but had been maintained 
This is easy cycling as Seville is flat ! 
The time literally flew by and on arrival back at the bike shop
author: Sharon_G

title: Sunny seville on a bike!
text: We had the best time with Emilio! Fun, interesting, factual and very easy cycling. A great way to get your bearings in the city while also learning some history. Can highly recommend!
author: Onnymc

title: Super way to see Seville
text: Outstanding history lesson taking in all the major sites and plenty of lesser known. Our guide Emilio was a Seville  history book on two wheels. Good bikes , flat city and issued with water for the sunny ride. Can highly recommend
author: djwalms

title: Emilio is a Terrific Guide.
text: Emilio is so enthusiastic and well-educated about the city's history and modern features. My husband and I were solo with him, so he customized the pace and stops to our interests/needs. We loved our time and learned so much. Highly recommend!
author: Getaway44199952841

title: Seville bike tour
text: Excellent private tour with Pierre,  he was very knowledgeable and helpful.  Relaxing bike ride, we have learned a lot about Seville.  Would highly recommend the tour and especially Pierre.
author: P6342CVangelae

title: Outstanding!
text: Awesome! We had the best time on our private bike tour with Emilio.  He was very knowledgeable about the history of Spain, and specifically Seville. He was funny, easy going, and friendly. Highly recommend!
author: A2990ZRshannonh

title: I felt safe and comfortable on the tour.
text: Great fun and a learning opportunity. Fernando was knowledgeable, professional and passionate about Seville’s history.
author: Mark_A

title: Amazing private tour of Seville!
text: We booking a private tour with Milena and it was fantastic! We learnt so much about Seville - it's the perfect thing to do at the start of a stay in Seville, for the rest of our time there we were recalling all she told us - HIGHLY recommend!
